meta.name: alterlab-scgpt
meta.description: Apply the scGPT single-cell foundation model (Cui 2024) to annotate and embed cells — zero-shot and fine-tuned cell-type annotation, gene/cell embeddings, batch integration, and gene-regulatory / perturbation inference from AnnData. Use when annotating cell types with a pretrained foundation model, generating scGPT embeddings, integrating batches with a transformer, or running zero-shot single-cell inference on an h5ad. For probabilistic latent models (scVI/scANVI) prefer alterlab-scvi-tools; for the standard QC→cluster→UMAP→DE pipeline prefer alterlab-scanpy; for the AnnData data structure itself prefer alterlab-anndata; for protein language models prefer alterlab-esm. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用单细胞转录组数据做细胞类型注释或基因调控推断
copy.tagline_en: Annotate cell types and generate embeddings with a pretrained foundation model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working with single-cell transcriptomics data for cell type annotation or gene regulatory inference

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 scGPT 模型分析单细胞数据，自动标注细胞类型、生成细胞或基因的嵌入向量、整合不同批次的数据，以及推断基因调控关系。
howto.when: 当用户要求用预训练模型标注细胞类型、生成 scGPT 嵌入、整合批次或对 h5ad 文件进行零样本推断时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 scGPT 零样本标注这个 h5ad 文件的细胞类型。
say.note: Claude 会加载预训练模型并输出细胞类型标签。

say.text: 用 scGPT 生成细胞嵌入，然后做聚类和 UMAP。
say.note: Claude 会计算嵌入并传递给 Scanpy 流程。

say.text: 用 scGPT 整合两个不同批次的单细胞数据。
say.note: Claude 会使用模型表示进行批次校正。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the scGPT model to analyze single-cell data: automatically annotate cell types, generate cell or gene embeddings, integrate batches, and infer gene regulatory relationships.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to annotate cell types with a pretrained foundation model, generate scGPT embeddings, integrate batches, or run zero-shot inference on an h5ad file.

say_en.text: Use scGPT to zero-shot annotate cell types in this h5ad file.
say_en.note: Claude loads the pretrained model and outputs cell type labels.

say_en.text: Generate cell embeddings with scGPT, then cluster and run UMAP.
say_en.note: Claude computes embeddings and passes them to the Scanpy workflow.

say_en.text: Integrate two batches of single-cell data using scGPT.
say_en.note: Claude uses the model representation for batch correction.
